nom: COSRX The Retinol 0.5 Oil with Super Vitamin E + Squalane

avis.texte: I love this!! I started out 2 days a week. With no irritation or breakouts. I apply my hyaluronic Olay hydrating lotion after I apply my rentinol with no side effects. My skin feels so soft and smooth the next morning. I am also starting to notice small differences in my lines and wrinkles around my eyes aren't as prominent. Will definitely buy this again.

My esti bestie suggested I stsrt using retnoid around my eyes, and I already had this on hand. I can't use it on my whole face, but it is my holy grail around my eyes. I've been using it consistently for a month or two and I see such a difference.

i have a nervous habit of picking my face and have had a large dark spot for several monthe from one spot after just one use it was reduced by 70%. i respond well to these treatments but rarely that well. dont forget the sunscreen to keep the progress!

I needed to get back on retinol after almost 3 years due to being pregnant and nursing. This stuff is very gentle, it doesn't irritate my skin at all. I put a tiny drop on both cheeks, forehead, and chin which i believe it more than what it says to out and work that everywhere including my neck. I try to press more than rub. Let it dry a bit then follow with my night moisturizer. I use it every other night, alternating with another serum. But if i feel my skin is dull, i have a lot of dead skin or texture, the very next morning after using this i immediately notice a difference. I'm not saying it's curing all of my acne, darkmarks, texture overnight but in the morning i can see my face does look brighter, smoother, feels softer, and just looks more youthful. Throughout the day i can appreciate that. No one recommended this to me, i was looking for a retinol product that actually contains retinol- lol- and was not too pricey. I lucked out, i love this stuff.

I turned 30 and this is saving my skin!! My skin has been drying out from using other acne treatments, and this is the only thing that helps with acne and dry skin! even though it's an oil, it doesn't clog my pores!

I started using this retinol abouth a month ago and I've already noticed more even skin texture and my skin is glowing. It's not harsh like some other retinols so it's good for sensitive skin. I do noticed the TINIEST amount of peeling if I don't moisturize enough but barely anything to complain about. Overall a great retinol for people beginnjng their retinol journey! :)

avis.titre: It's fine, a bit oily feeling
avis.texte: I've only been using this retinol serum for a week, so I can't speak to how well it works, but I will say its far more oily feeling than other retinols I've used. After application, my skin looks and feels oily for quite some time.

This product changed my life. I was dealing with breakouts and textured skin before I began using this. Three months later my skin is the clearest it's ever been ; I have no breakouts in sight and my skin looks like a glazed donut. I sandwich this product between two moisturizers and that seems to keep any irritation from occuring. Give the product a few months to work, you won't regret it !
Amazing retinol. I use every night right before bed and wake up with glowing skin and diminished wrinkles.
This helps wirh acne scaring and fine lines its not like some retinol that makes your skin purge and break out its some how gentle but helps amazingly

avis.titre: I'm glowing! And my skin is looking better!!
avis.texte: Needed to increase the retinol % since my last bottle didn't do much for me so i got this. I noticed results after 3 months, using it 2 times a week at night. Zero purging! I've been glowing way more than usual and my skin texture has improved so much! Fyi, i have oily, acne-prone, and dehydrated skin. I highly recommend this if ur an experienced retinol user Also i think that putting it in the fridge also gave me better results!

It's very gentle (no adverse reaction), but I can't tell if it's working. I have not seen any significant difference. I also find the packaging a bit clunky; it has a very short dropper and an opaque glass, making it impossible to gauge what's left.
Light oil type fluid solution that applies great and leaves skin dewy. Seems to be working as part of my nightly skin care routine.

Best replacement for a product discontinued by decium. I like that it's a stronger AMT of retinol than the cream. I also usually use an oil as the last step in an evening routine so retinol oils are great for a kind of 2 in 1 step as long as I've used other humectants under it.

I love this. I find that if I don't use it one evening, my skin really misses it, and I miss it in my routine. It's a gentle enough that I don't feel like I can't use it every day, yet I still see results. my skin is calmer and more radiant. I have only started using retinol's in the past year, and this is by far my favorite formula. I received this complementary to test, and I have so glad I did. My bottle is almost gone, and I will definitely be repurchasing.
I'm currently on my second bottle! This formulation is gentle very effective. After use, my skin is left glowing and feeling smooth.

I received this product for free from Influenster and COSRX. However, my review is honest and my own. I love how this feels during application to the skin. The smoothness is like a dream. I definitely saw and felt immediate moisture relief and felt glowy. I do think it has helped a little so far with fine lines. No irritation as of yet.

Great addition to your nighttime routine. Results take time but that's with any retinol. Gentle enough to be used daily, if you've built a tolerance. Def would recommend to anyone who's wanting try incorporate or try a new retinol

avis.titre: One of the best oil serums I've used
avis.texte: I really love this serum. I'm 28, so I'm using it more as a preventive measure, a few drops at night every other day. It really smooths my skin and makes me look so much more glowy and even. I really appreciate this product and will keep buying it!

avis.titre: Smooth product leaves me with smooth skin
avis.texte: This product is really nice. I use it as directed, couple of drops, and I never experience dry skin. I use it at night and the next day my skin looks hydrated and plump. Honestly if you use retinol, then you will recognize the quality of the serum! It's so smooth. I love this product and will continue to buy!
Made my skin glow. My face soaked up this oil and gave it a smooth finish.

I've tried a couple of different retinol products and this is by far the best! It is not drying (quite moisturizing actually) and doesn't irritate my skin at all. I feel as though it's improved the evenness of my skin.

I love getting products from influenster and COSRX for free in exchange for my honest review! I use this every morning under my makeup and after I wash my face at night. This oil does not have much of a smell and goes on silky smooth! You dont need a whole dropper full, just a few drops covers the entire neck and face area. I love that it works well with my sensitive skin. I can tell the wrinkles under my eyes are not as profound as they were a few months back and I like that!

I really liked this product. I needed more time review it. I was really impressed with the ingredients. I would definitely purchase this again and would recommend to others. I received this product for free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review.
I love this bc this doesn't destroy your skin barrier. Even though I have dry skin, it doesn't dry me out.
Absolutely awesome. I have used other retinol products but this just left my skin radiant and loved the texture too
I like the way it feels! I havent' used it long enough to notice a huge difference. But it does feel nice and makes my skin look good.
I have really sensitive and I mixed this into my moisturizer and so far I haven't had any breakouts. So far so good.

I was looking for a stronger retinol after using a 0.3% product for the past year. Really loving this product so far! No irritation yet but I've been starting slow and gradual as recommended. I was even able to use very little around the eye area and noticed my fine lines look less pronounced. I love how quickly it absorbs too. Affordable price for a retinol product which I can appreciate.

At first I was concerned about the intensity of it, having only used retinol creams and the first few drops felt a little stingy. But over time it got easier and easier. I felt my skin craving it in the evenings. It left my skin feeling supple and in the mornings my lines weren't as deep compared to the days I wouldn't use it. Keeps me feeling smooth and moisturized.
I only recently swapped to this retinol so I can't quite yet rate it's efficiency but it feels great so far!
I have really sensitive and reactive skin but i mixed this into my moisturizer and so far i haven't had any breakouts.Try to mix it into a simple moisturizer to balance it out.
Absolutely unbelievable! Definitely has helps some of my settled lines in just 2 weeks!
Retinol helped a lot with fine lines and discoloration. I would highly recommend.
I saw good results with this product it helps minimize appearance of wrinkles and with some of my pigment issues. I will definitely keep this with other skin care products.

Within a week of using the retinol 2x a week I could see a noticeable difference in the overall texture and tone of my face and neck. Also I have very sensitive skin and this formula did not irritate me at all!
It's pretty good. I got it complimentary from Influenster. Can't say i seen any results.

Started using the 0.1% retinol, then to this 0.5%. It's really not drying and doesn't cause any irritation to skin. Cosrx products are really great, since I've started using, got many compliments on my skin which use to be very rough and dry.

Love this product! You definitely go through the dry peeling stages before it stops and you see improvements. I use this in combination with other products and have seen an improvement in my skin texture.
Great product. I have only been using for a few days but feels great and I already see a difference in my skin.
This product is amazing. My skin looks so much healthier. I will be 40 this year so this will now be a permanent fixture in my skincare routine.
Loved the Retinol 0.5 Oil, it really balances my skin which is perfect due to my strenuous travel schedule which wreaks havoc on my skin. First time using this product and would highly recommend.
Great oil. Not greasy, very moisturizing. Excellent second step to adjust to retinol.

avis.titre: Good but can be harsh if you have skin issues
avis.texte: I have perioral dermatitis, so I wanted to love this. But it did trigger my PD. I'm gonna give it another shot ans hope it doesn't do that again. However I loved the feeling of it upon application and it didn't stink.
Great for sensitive skin. Daily use without irritation. Perfect for someone who's looking to get into retinols.
I have sensitive skin and I am worried about products breaking me out. This retinol is perfect for me, I have noticed a big difference in the health of my skin.

This is my first time using retinol and am amazed to see a softening of the fine lines around my eyes after only a few uses! It is super easy to add this into my evening skin care routine a couple nights per week. I can't wait to see how my skin continues to become even more hydrated over time. Thanks for the fantastic product and price.

avis.titre: Where has this been all my life!?
avis.texte: I purchased CosRx's Retinol 0.5 Oil as soon as it launched a few months back. I was excited to try retinol in a different form than I had been using, hoping for a less abrasive approach. I am so glad I opted to try this! This is oil is fantastic! It has all the same benefits of the previous retinol I was using without the terrible drying and flaking side effects. I know with retinol to expect that dryness and flakiness; however, with this product there was much more of an ease transitioning my skin to tolerate it every other night and then eventually every night. The texture is not too greasy or heavy while also not being so lightweight that you feel it is underwhelming either. I highly recommend!

avis.titre: Wasn't ideal and didn't fit for me
avis.texte: So the only reason I didn't rate this lower is because I don't think I used this regularly enough to get the benefit out of it. Its hard to add retinol to a routine when your am routine has vit c and nighttime has niacinimide and other actives. Every time I switched out the other actives for retinol I would get acne to surface (which I get happens with retinol) and I would end up just feeling frustrated that I didn't use my other actives instead. Its easier for me to integrate bakuchiol into my routine tbh, which I use regularly. The last detriment to this product is that its only 20ml (the entire active/serum line is 20ml sized bottles). Made me feel a bit baited tbh bc I bought 4 of the serums and assumed they'd be the standard 30ml size most serums are. If you math out the difference these serums are technically more expensive than how they?셱e being marketed. Cosrx is an iconic brand but that was very disappointing.
I had to stop using my prescribed vitamin A, because it was causing too much dryness. I love this because it works well for my dry sensitive skin.

I am loving this new addition to my routine! I use 2 drops at night every couple of days. I figured out that I had to start out using it every 4-5 days because trying every 3 days made me have a minor breakout. I did that for a couple weeks then moved to using it every 2-3 days. The added squalane makes the oil so silky smooth. My skin feels softer and smoother.
It helps in breakout. Making my skin super soft. Very good product. I wish I had come across to it earlier Works great. Thank you COSRX
The product has been great for my skin! The product did not dry my skin out at all! I use it once to twice a week. Very easy to use and fits nicely inside my fridge for a cold application.

After researching different kinds of skincare products for my aging skin, I decided to give Cosrx retinol 0.5 oil a try based on its positive reviews. I wish I have done it earlier! I am very happy with the improvements in my skin tone and texture. The retinol 0.5 oil will continue be part of my skincare routine for a long time.

This retinol was a step up from my previous one. I saw a noticeable difference pretty soon after starting use. I use it every other day ony face a neck and can generally see a reduction in lines the next morning. My skin has felt smooth, the application is easy, and i have recommended it to friends.

My first retinol experience and it works wonders. It pairs amazingly with the COSRX niacinamide serum and snail mucin power essence. It has evened out my skin tone. I use it twice weekly after getting my skin used to it for the first two weeks. No complaint about the scent of the product either. My only complaint is the container, after using most of the product, it's hard to use the dropper. You'd have to pour the retinol out.
I have been using it for more than 3 months now . I have noticed some fine lines on my forehead disappearing

This product leaves the skin so smooth and bouncy feeling. I use on my face, neck and chest. No irritation, really enjoy this in my skin care regimen. I use it along with the hyaluronic acid, perfect combination.
It's wonderful, it leaves my skin smooth and soft.. Love it..:heart_eyes:
Second time purchasing. This retinol product is silky smooth and feels moisturizing. I use retinol serums as well but love this oil form.
The product works. In the morning my face looks much more healed and restored. A great retinol! The smell is okay, could be better. I may try the cream version next time.
My skin is glowing and looks so hydrating, I have a dark spot on my face and using cosrx products make my complexion better

I haven't been using it for too long but overall I have liking the product. It feels very hydrating and my complexion is looking smoother! I do have oily skin and don't feel like this makes me oiler but I do only use this at night. I've recently turned 30 so adding a retinol to my routine was important for me to prevent the wrinkles and fine lines :slightly_smiling: I can't say anything about breakouts right now but I do mostly face hormonal acne around my time of the month.

My skin had looked progressively better since I've started using retinol. Less breakouts, more even skin tone and this formula works well with other products. I had an issue with product pilling but this is smooth. Price is great compared to competitors, would definitely recommend trying!

This retinol is absolutely amazing! I love the formula and never experienced any irritation like I have with most retinols. I've since ran out (need to order more ASAP) and see/feel a difference in my skin when I have not using it! 10/10 I recommend this retinol to everyone I know!
I've seen quick results in comparison to other products I've used. And I have most delighted that this treatment is affordable!

I have not an expert skincare user, this is the first retinol I've ever tried but I LOVE the formula. Super hydrating, the quality of the formula is really nice. It leaves my skins feeling dewy and firm, never drying and I haven't experienced any sort of breakouts. I feel it has helped clear up my skin.
This product applies really great. Great way to introduce retinol into your routine. I never forget to use it at night
I love the quality of this product. I use it for skin cycling and it has been very good to my skin. It leaves my complexion glowing.
Bought this for my mother who is in her 70s. She absolutely loves it and is seeing results already. It's really helping with her wrinkles and fine lines. It's a great product at a great price!

Following the recommended application and frequency was key to prevent irritation and dryness. I have very sensitive skin and was very impressed how gentle it was on my skin. Definitely reduced the appearance of texture and increased firmness within weeks.
This product is amazing, the consistency is very pleasant is much easier to use than other products on the market.

It's a decent size for the price listed. I've been using it every other night and it's not thick or heavy at all. It's perfectly lightweight but doesn't instantly disappear like some face oils I've tried in the past which I personally prefer. It makes my skin feel moisturized before even adding moisturizer on top. Also, I feel as though it's helping my neck lines fade. Definitely like this oil a lot and would recommend this to anyone looking for a good retinol.

avis.titre: Sensitive skin approved. Not functional bottle shape
avis.texte: The product is fantastic. My sensitive skin and eczema was happy with the dose. Unfortunately the shape of the bottle and the length of the dropper is not great. It made it very difficult to get product out and had to tilt the bottle for a 4th of the time using it.
Great retinol for advanced users. I can use this once or twice a week without irritation or peeling. It leaves my skin feeling nourished and smooth.

I received this from Influenster and COSRX and I couldn't have been happier with this product! I've never used a retinol oil before but I was super impressed with this one. Living in Michigan during the winter means dry skin even with moisturizer, but once I started using this before my moisturizer my skin looked and felt amazing.

I received these products for feee from Influenster and brands in exchange for my honest review I have been using this product the past 3 months. I use about 5 drops total 2-3 nights a week. I had been wanting to try a retinol oil but was always a little hesitant. Other facial products tend to break my face out but with this oil I immediately saw improvements. The fine lines on my forehead are beginning to be less noticeable and the black heads on my nose are slowly going away. I can see myself continuing to use this product!
I used this for 3 weeks now and I have noticed the difference on my fine lines! It works like magic! I love this oil so much!

avis.titre: Great Retinol, But More Suitable for Beginners
avis.texte: I received this product from Influenster to provide a review on. Gray retinol, but this is much more suitable for someone trying retinol for the first time. I lean towards retin-a and multi acid options, so this didn't do much for me. I passed it over to a friend and they absolutely love it.

This was my first time using a retinol, and I loved it! It's perfect for adding firmness, smoothness, and giving you that radiant glow. The product came with an instruction manual. I really appreciated that because I have new to using retinol products. The bottle was a lot bigger than I expected and it came with a dropper as well. Since this is a pure retinol product, it's best to keep it in the fridge. I found that to be very refreshing after a nice warm shower. I noticed a difference in my skin pretty quickly and I have excited to keep using, COSRX!
I absolutely love this Retinol!! Its so gentle and have really transformed my skin!! Thank you Cosrx for sending me this to review.

This Retinol oil is so lightweight and it doesn't clog my pores at all. I have extremely dry, textured, and dehydrated skin and this is the perfect last step to my routine. Perfect for sealing in the moisture without a greasy look or feel. Usually I avoid oils and tend to go for a pretty thick layer of Vaseline at night to slug with and this actually pairs really well with a lighter layer of that, but also feels great on its own. Really absorbs into the skin and makes it look glowy and hasn't left my skin dry, itchy, or flakey even combined with a retinol cream. Somehow only a drop or 2 covers my entire face and neck. Pure magic, highly recommend.

I really am skeptical with any new skin care routine since I have rosacea and my skin is extremely sensitive. I was surprised on how non-greasy this was and that my skin had zero irritation. I could see results after three weeks on the fine lines between my eyebrows and at my temple. I keep this in a mini makeup fridge so the product stays chilled. I think it helps. I've continued to use this with no bad reactions. I received this product free through COSRX and influenster in exchange for a review of my honest opinion.
I love the packaging that it comes in-the bottle is simple but feels luxurious. I kept it in the fridge and it really enhanced the application experience. I enjoyed adding it to my skincare routine.
I have breakout but this work on my face but it burns my face

COSRX is becoming one of my new favorite skincare lines. This product is moisturizing and I can see a difference in my skintone, firmness, etc. I will look more into this product too as a staple in my skincare regiment.
One thing I noticed was that my pores on nose and forehead look smaller. I didn't notice any irritation on face and neck. My skin does look more even and smooth.
Really enjoy this product! Doesnt leave a greasy film on your skin
Didn't sting, felt great going on. Noticed a change in my skin after the first week or so. Would definitely buy again. Everyone needs to try this.
This retinol is not one of my favorites, for me it is a bit oily and it lasts a bit in its absorption and its smell is a bit strong and I don't like it
Love, love, love how this serum doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. My skin is loving the way it feels, brighter and even toned.

I've used this product which I received from influensterfor testing. It's about a month and a half and I can honestly tell you that I'm getting another bottle. A little goes a long way and my skin is literally thanking me. Korean skin care product often never disappoint that's for sure.
I really liked this product. It felt very hydrating on my skin! It absorbs very well. I've been using this for several weeks and can see a difference in my complexion.

My complexion has improved tremendously. I have hooked on this product and will make it a regular part of my routine. As I age, my concern about signs of aging have increased. My skin is brighter and even.
It's very hydrating and has a high concentration on my skin for long period

I used this for 2 weeks at night only and saw results. I was unable to take a proper photo as I broke out with acne and couldnt show the results properly. The product claims to help with wrinkles, improve elasticity, lifting, and reduces pore visibility. I saw in my skin a little bit of lifting abd elasticity. Im pretty yound still so no wrinkles as of yet, and i couldnt use this under my eyes as i was already using a serum. The product had no scent and was easy to apply. I dont have a fridge for my skincare, so mine was never cold when using it. Idk if i would have done that if it would have made any difference or not.

avis.titre: Help to remove acne markings after 2 months
avis.texte: This retinol product was my first try. So I became a new retinol fan. After 2 months of daily usage, I noticed it helped to remove some acne markings. Please notice the concentration is small so it takes time to see any improvement. The above is also true of other retinol products. I'm continuing to use this product. I definitely will buy it again.
Feels great on skin. Even after a few uses I feel it is helping repair my skin overall from acne scaring.
I was using the retinol cream but felt that I could use the oil. It really works fast. I got the peeling but it didn't dry out my face in the process.

I received this product for free from Influenster in exchange for my honest opinion! While I don't see a huge different i can say i have only done this once a week because i have never used a retinol before! I love that it has squalene to keep the moisture and it didn't dry my skin out! I am going to increase to 2 times a week and see if i notice more change!
